title: Realistic iron x Old ores
description: This pack adds compatibility between Old Ores and Realistic Iron
body: This pack adds compatibility between Old Ores and Realistic Iron, which adds new textures to iron items and blocks inspired by real life iron ores, the blocks and items that this texture pack changes are: the iron ore, deepslate iron ore and raw iron. Thanks for reading this description.![This is how you need to arrange the texture packs for it to work.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41e43633dc72b8f8e64b934f7c9bea2ea5caf10a.png)
